meta.title: Appendix D: Glossary
meta.summary: Czech-English glossary of the package's terms with a short meaning and a reference to the chapter that governs the term.

title: Appendix D: Glossary
summary: The glossary unifies terminology across the chapters. Each term lists the English equivalent as Microsoft uses it, a short meaning, and the chapter that governs the term. Where the Czech translation has several variants, the package uses the one given here.

sections.title: Roles and governance
sections.html:
Roles and governance

TermEnglishMeaningChapter
SponzorSponsorA member of leadership who backs governance, approves the selection of chapters, and settles disputes.GOV-01
Governance leadGovernance leadThe person responsible for adopting and maintaining governance; the owner of the package within the company.GOV-01, GOV-02
Governance výborGovernance boardA group of representatives of IT, business, and security that decides on rules and exceptions.GOV-01
Globální správceGlobal AdministratorThe highest role in Microsoft 365; restricted to the necessary minimum of accounts.GOV-02, GOV-09
Správce SharePointuSharePoint administratorThe role that manages SharePoint and OneDrive settings in the tenant.GOV-02
Bezpečnostní správceSecurity administratorThe role that manages Conditional Access, DLP, and security alerts.GOV-02, GOV-11
Compliance správceCompliance administratorThe role that manages retention, eDiscovery, and audit in Microsoft Purview.GOV-12
Správce vyhledáváníSearch administratorThe role that manages Microsoft Search: bookmarks, acronyms, verticals.GOV-13
Vlastník hubuHub ownerResponsible for the navigation, theme, and associated sites of the hub.GOV-05
Vlastník webuSite ownerResponsible for the permissions, sharing, guests, and content of the site; every site has two.GOV-02, GOV-06
Člen, návštěvníkMember, visitorThe standard site groups with the right to edit and to read only, respectively.GOV-09
ChampionChampionAn employee who helps with adoption in their team and is the first line for questions.GOV-18
Redaktor, autor obsahuEditor, content authorThe person who publishes pages and news on the intranet, and the person who creates documents, respectively.GOV-15, GOV-07
Tvůrce Power PlatformPower Platform makerThe person who builds apps and flows in Power Apps and Power Automate.GOV-16
Politika, směrnice, standard, postupPolicy, guideline, standard, procedureBinding rules, recommendations, technical setting values, process steps.GOV-03
VýjimkaExceptionAn approved and time-limited deviation from a rule, recorded in the exception register.GOV-03
Úroveň (Základ, Standard, Pokročilé)Level (Basic, Standard, Advanced)The three degrees of rigor of the rules in every chapter.GOV-00
Hodnocení zralostiMaturity assessmentThe 18-area questionnaire with an L0–L3 scale on which the selection of chapters is based.GOV-00, GOV-23

sections.title: Structure and content
sections.html:
Structure and content

TermEnglishMeaningChapter
TenantTenantThe company's Microsoft 365 instance with all its services and data.GOV-00
WebSiteThe basic unit of SharePoint: team, communication, or group-connected.GOV-05, GOV-06
Kolekce webůSite collectionA site including its settings, permissions, and recycle bin; in modern SharePoint one site = one collection.GOV-05
PodwebSubsiteA site nested under another site; not used in modern architecture.GOV-05
HubHub siteA site that groups other sites under shared navigation, theme, and search.GOV-05
Domovský webHome siteThe intranet landing page connected to global navigation and the SharePoint app in Teams.GOV-05
Skupina Microsoft 365Microsoft 365 groupA group in Microsoft Entra that carries a team, a site, a mailbox, and a plan.GOV-06
Tým, kanál, sdílený kanálTeam, channel, shared channelA Microsoft Teams team on top of a group; channels with their own folder; a shared channel for external organizations.GOV-06, GOV-10
Knihovna dokumentů, seznamDocument library, listStorage for files and for structured items on a site, respectively.GOV-07
Typ obsahuContent typeA template for an item or document with metadata and behavior, shared across sites.GOV-05, GOV-07
Spravovaná metadata, úložiště termínůManaged metadata, term storeCentral vocabularies of values (department, document type) for columns and search.GOV-05
VerzováníVersioningThe version history of a document; the Automatic mode trims old versions by age.GOV-07, GOV-20
Schvalování obsahuContent approvalPublication of an item or page only after approval.GOV-07, GOV-15
RezervaceCheck-outLocking a document for a single editor; used only exceptionally.GOV-07
Cílení na publikumAudience targetingShowing navigation, news, or web parts only to selected groups.GOV-05, GOV-15
Konvence pojmenováníNaming conventionRules for the names of groups, sites, libraries, files, and other objects.GOV-04
Naming policy skupinGroup naming policyA Microsoft Entra setting that enforces a prefix, suffix, and blocked words for groups.GOV-04
Expirace skupinGroup expiration policyAutomatic expiration of inactive Microsoft 365 groups with renewal by the owner.GOV-06
Neaktivní webInactive siteA site without activity for a set period; a SAM policy turns it read-only or archives it.GOV-06
Potvrzení stavu webu (attestace)Site attestationThe owner's periodic confirmation that the site is still needed and correctly configured.GOV-06
Zásada vlastnictví webuSite ownership policyA SAM policy that watches the minimum number of owners and their departure.GOV-02, GOV-06
ArchivaceArchivingMoving an inactive site to Microsoft 365 Archive or to read-only mode.GOV-06, GOV-12
Vyřazení webuSite decommissioningControlled end of a site: hold check, export, notification, deletion.GOV-06
Koš, druhá úroveň košeRecycle bin, second-stage recycle binStorage for deleted items for 93 days; a deleted site remains recoverable for 93 days.GOV-20
Obnovení knihovnyLibrary restoreReturning an entire library or OneDrive to its state at any point in the last 30 days.GOV-20

sections.title: Access, sharing and protection
sections.html:
Access, sharing and protection

TermEnglishMeaningChapter
Dědičnost oprávněníPermission inheritanceA site, library, and item inherit permissions from the parent level; breaking it creates unique permissions.GOV-09
Jedinečná oprávněníUnique permissionsPermissions set outside inheritance; a recorded exception.GOV-09
Úroveň oprávněníPermission levelA set of rights (Full Control, Edit, Read); custom levels are not introduced.GOV-09
Everyone except external users (EEEU)Everyone except external usersA claim that includes all internal users; prohibited outside the intranet.GOV-09, GOV-17
Restricted Access Control (RAC)Restricted Access ControlA SAM feature that restricts access to a site to listed groups only, regardless of sharing.GOV-09, GOV-17
Přehled přístupůAccess reviewPeriodic confirmation of who should have access; in Microsoft Entra or as a site access review in SAM.GOV-09, GOV-10
Podmíněný přístupConditional AccessMicrosoft Entra policies that control sign-in based on user, device, location, and risk.GOV-09
Vícefázové ověření (MFA)Multi-factor authenticationA second factor at sign-in; mandatory for all users and guests.GOV-09
PIMPrivileged Identity ManagementTime-limited activation of administrator roles with approval and audit.GOV-02, GOV-09
App-only přístupApp-only accessAn application's access to content without a signed-in user; recorded and minimized.GOV-09, GOV-16
Externí sdíleníExternal sharingMaking content available to people outside the tenant.GOV-10
HostGuestAn external user with a B2B account in the company's Microsoft Entra.GOV-10
Anonymní odkaz („Kdokoli“)Anyone linkA link without sign-in; disabled outside approved exceptions.GOV-10
Odkaz pro lidi v organizaciPeople in your organization linkA link that works for any signed-in user of the tenant.GOV-10
Odkaz pro konkrétní lidiSpecific people linkA link that works only for the named people; the default link type.GOV-10
Cross-tenant accessCross-tenant access settingsMicrosoft Entra settings for trust and restrictions toward specific partner tenants.GOV-10
KlasifikaceClassificationAssigning information to the level Public, Internal, Confidential, or Highly Confidential.GOV-11
Štítek citlivostiSensitivity labelA Microsoft Purview label on a file, email, site, or team that carries classification and protection.GOV-11
Štítek kontejneruContainer labelA sensitivity label on a site, team, or group that controls privacy, external sharing, and devices.GOV-11, GOV-10
Výchozí štítek knihovnyDefault library labelThe label a library assigns to new documents that have no label.GOV-11
DLPData loss preventionPurview policies that detect sensitive information and block its sharing or sending.GOV-11
Nadměrné sdílení (oversharing)OversharingA state in which more people can see content than necessary; Copilot makes it visible.GOV-09, GOV-17

sections.title: Retention, audit and operations
sections.html:
Retention, audit and operations

TermEnglishMeaningChapter
Zásady uchováváníRetention policyA Purview "retain and then delete" policy for an entire location (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams).GOV-12
Štítek uchováváníRetention labelA label on a document with its own retention period; it can turn the document into a record.GOV-12
Záznam (record)RecordA document that, once labeled, cannot be changed or deleted until the retention period ends.GOV-12
Disposition reviewDisposition reviewA check before deletion after the retention period ends.GOV-12
SkartaceDisposalControlled permanent deletion of content after the retention period ends, with a log kept.GOV-12
Blokace z právních důvodů (legal hold)Legal holdSuspending the deletion of content because of a dispute or investigation.GOV-12
eDiscoveryeDiscoveryFinding, preserving, and exporting content for legal purposes in Purview.GOV-12
Auditní logAudit logA record of user and administrator actions in Microsoft 365; 180 days, with Purview (E5) one year.GOV-19
Zásady upozorněníAlert policiesAutomatic alerts on mass sharing, deletion, or anomalies.GOV-19, GOV-21
Data Access Governance (DAG)Data Access GovernanceSAM reports on sharing links, permissions, labels, and EEEU.GOV-09, GOV-19
Restricted Content Discovery (RCD)Restricted Content DiscoveryA SAM feature that excludes a site from organization-wide search and Copilot.GOV-13, GOV-17
Sémantický indexSemantic indexThe Microsoft 365 index that Copilot searches over; it cannot be turned off, but a site can be excluded.GOV-17
AgentAgentAn AI assistant over selected content: a SharePoint agent, Copilot in SharePoint, a Copilot Studio agent.GOV-17
Microsoft 365 BackupMicrosoft 365 BackupA paid backup of SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange with restore points and a window of up to 2 years.GOV-20
Microsoft 365 ArchiveMicrosoft 365 ArchiveLow-cost storage for inactive sites; the content is in eDiscovery, not in Copilot.GOV-06, GOV-12
RPO, RTORPO, RTOThe acceptable data loss in time and the acceptable recovery time, respectively.GOV-20
Runbook, playbookRunbook, playbookA step-by-step procedure for an operational scenario or an incident.GOV-20, GOV-21
IncidentIncidentAn event that threatens the confidentiality, availability, or integrity of content.GOV-21
Message CenterMessage CenterMicrosoft's channel for announcements about changes and feature retirements.GOV-22
Targeted releaseTargeted releaseEarlier availability of new features to a selected pilot group.GOV-22
SAMSharePoint Advanced ManagementA set of advanced SharePoint management features; unlocked by a Copilot license, the Plan 1 add-on, or E7.GOV-00
KPIKPIA measurable indicator with a target, a data source, and a cadence.GOV-23
